<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tray" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9747FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1B0188"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#DCDCDC" flood-opacity=".75"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">9:41</text>
  <line x1="318" y1="18" x2="318" y2="12" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="323" y1="18" x2="323" y2="10" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="18" x2="328" y2="8" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="344" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M339 14 Q344 8 349 14" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="8" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="10" width="15" height="8" rx="2" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <rect x="382" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="31,59 24,65 31,71" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="65" x2="39" y2="65" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="55" y="70" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Tu viaje</text>
  <circle cx="354" cy="59" r="4" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <line x1="354" y1="66" x2="354" y2="74" stroke="#0BAEAF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="354" cy="78" r="2" fill="#0BAEAF"/>

  <!-- main loading content -->
  <text x="195" y="131" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Estamos preparando tu viaje</text>
  <text x="195" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Estamos confirmando tus asientos</text>

  <!-- large seat selection illustration shadow -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="42" y="190" width="306" height="360" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- window -->
  <rect x="69" y="216" width="250" height="120" rx="14" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
  <circle cx="276" cy="251" r="20" fill="#FFF9E6"/>
  <polygon points="83,324 145,267 184,302 218,274 300,324" fill="#9747FF" opacity=".62"/>
  <polygon points="83,324 145,285 175,309 218,293 300,324" fill="#0BAEAF" opacity=".7"/>
  <path d="M75 314 Q150 276 225 308 T319 291" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" opacity=".8"/>
  <path d="M76 326 Q170 295 246 322 T317 315" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity=".7"/>

  <!-- airplane seat illustration -->
  <rect x="116" y="366" width="158" height="105" rx="30" fill="#1B0188"/>
  <rect x="139" y="345" width="112" height="96" rx="28" fill="#9747FF"/>
  <rect x="154" y="361" width="82" height="65" rx="18" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
  <rect x="151" y="433" width="88" height="16" rx="7" fill="#110053"/>
  <rect x="106" y="458" width="178" height="15" rx="7" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <circle cx="141" cy="383" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="249" cy="383" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="130" cy="485" r="13" fill="#EA104C"/>
  <circle cx="260" cy="485" r="13" fill="#EA104C"/>
  <path d="M104 471 Q91 485 104 498" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="5"/>
  <path d="M286 471 Q299 485 286 498" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="5"/>

  <!-- floating selection indicators -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="80" cy="382" r="18" fill="#1B0188"/>
    <text x="80" y="388" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">A</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="310" cy="414" r="18" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <text x="310" y="420" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">✓</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="84" cy="515" r="18" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <text x="84" y="521" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">12</text>
  </g>

  <!-- progress dots -->
  <circle cx="170" cy="521" r="5" fill="#9747FF"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="521" r="5" fill="#D1D1D2"/>
  <circle cx="220" cy="521" r="5" fill="#D1D1D2"/>

  <!-- reminder -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="578" r="12" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <polyline points="38,578 42,582 49,574" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="64" y="574" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">No cierres esta pantalla</text>
  <text x="64" y="594" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Te avisaremos cuando todo esté listo.</text>

  <!-- purple loading tray shadow -->
  <rect x="0" y="634" width="390" height="146" rx="14" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity=".65"/>
  <rect x="0" y="628" width="390" height="146" rx="14" fill="url(#tray)"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="672" r="22" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".18"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="672" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="16 8"/>
  <text x="80" y="665" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Procesando tu selección</text>
  <text x="80" y="689" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Esto puede tardar unos segundos</text>
  <rect x="27" y="716" width="336" height="7" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".25"/>
  <rect x="27" y="716" width="188" height="7" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="27" y="751" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Guardando asiento 12A</text>
  <text x="363" y="751" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">56%</text>

  <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="780" x2="390" y2="780" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,798 49,790 59,798 59,810 40,810" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="36,798 49,787 62,798" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="49" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Inicio</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="119" y="790" width="19" height="19" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="123" y1="796" x2="134" y2="796" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="123" y1="801" x2="132" y2="801" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="128" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Viajes</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="209" cy="798" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="209" y1="791" x2="209" y2="805" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="202" y1="798" x2="216" y2="798" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="209" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#9747FF">Ayuda</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="290" cy="796" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="290" cy="807" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="290" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuenta</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <line x1="353" y1="791" x2="370" y2="791" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="798" x2="370" y2="798" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="805" x2="370" y2="805" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="361" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Más</text>
  </g>
</svg>
